acoustic_scene.description: Longer regions describing the sound environment.

values.busy_street: outdoor city/street with clear traffic/crowd noise
values.restaurant_cafe: indoor food/drink place; voices, dishes, music, table noise
values.indoor_public: indoor public place: station, mall, museum, airport, etc.
values.transport: inside or near transport: car, bus, train, metro, plane
values.shop_market: shop, market, stall area, commercial street
values.tourist_landmark: sightseeing place, landmark, tourist attraction context

visual_context.description: Longer regions describing the visible situation.
visual_context.note: Use the dominant label, unless overlapping annotations are easy.

speech_activity.note: For the pilot, it is fine to annotate only speech and leave gaps unannotated.

values.non_speech: no speech; only silence, music, traffic, ambience, etc.
values.uncertain: maybe speech, but too unclear/noisy to decide

speaker_turn.note: Do not aim for perfect diarization in the pilot.

values.background_speaker: audible speech from people not part of main conversation
values.overlap: two or more speakers at the same time
values.unknown: speech present, but speaker role unclear

values.3_understandable_noisy: understandable, but noise clearly affects speech
values.1_unintelligible: speech detected, but meaning mostly lost

dominant_noise.note: Pick the dominant one, not every possible background sound.

values.restaurant_noise: dishes, tables, indoor crowd, cafe/restaurant ambience
values.vehicle: specific vehicle sound: bus, train, car interior, engine

speaker_visibility.description: Whether the speaking person is visible.

values.speaker_visible: speaking person visible enough to identify visually
values.speaker_partially_visible: partly visible: side, back, cropped, briefly visible
values.speaker_off_camera: main speaker audible but not visible

topic.description: Coarse topic of the spoken segment or scene.

values.travel_logistics: tickets, route, timing, hotel, transport, plans
values.directions: navigation, where to go, how to get somewhere

privacy_redaction.description: Mark spans that should be anonymized.

values.address: exact address or very specific location

notes.example: possible ASR error: "tournement de terre" probably "tremblement de terre"

values.free_text: anything unusual, uncertain, or worth checking later
